title: Aggregated Individual Reporting for Post-Deployment Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed as a hypothetical application of the Aggregated Individual Reporting (AIR) framework, where individual loan applicants submit demographic information and claims of discrimination to be aggregated and analyzed for disproportionate harm against financially-healthy Black applicants.

Discussed via a case study of the Mozilla RegretsReporter browser extension, which crowdsourced user feedback to determine that non-English speakers were disproportionately served regrettable content by YouTube's recommendation algorithm.
